candidates.name: Spinal meningioma
support_spans: A 35 × 9 mm sized mass occupying the spinal canal at T8-T9 level
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging studies suggest a spinal tumor, and the histopathological examination reveals a tumor with characteristics consistent with meningioma

candidates.name: Hemangioblastoma
support_spans: The lesion compressing the spinal cord from posterior showed peripheral rim enhancement around the central cystic area after contrast media injection
candidates.why: The imaging findings, particularly the cystic component and peripheral rim enhancement, are suggestive of hemangioblastoma

candidates.name: Neurofibroma
support_spans: Tumor consisted of elongated spindle cells with vesicular nucleus arrayed in a palisade pattern among large cystic cavities lined by single-layer squamous epithelium
candidates.why: The histopathological features, including the presence of spindle cells and cystic cavities, are consistent with neurofibroma

candidates.name: Schwannoma
support_spans: Neoplastic cells were negative for epithelial membrane antigen, pancytokeratin and desmin but diffuse positive for protein S-100
candidates.why: The immunohistochemical profile, including positivity for protein S-100, is consistent with schwannoma
